DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: チェックインですね。予約のお名前をお願いいたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're checking in. May I have the name on the reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: トラン・アンです。予約では名前の順番を逆に入力したかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約名の順序を誤入力した可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tran An. I may have entered my name in the reverse order when booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you may have entered the reservation name in the wrong order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前だけで見つからないため、予約番号も確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can't find it by name alone. May I also check your reservation number?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの確認メールに番号があります。二泊の一人部屋を予約しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 氏名順序の違うホテル予約の番号と二泊の条件を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: The number is in this confirmation email. I booked a single room for two nights.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Provide the reservation number and two-night booking details for the hotel reservation with the different name order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号で予約を見つけました。予約名はアン・トランになっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: I found the reservation using the number. The booking name is An Tran.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の身分証ではトラン・アンです。同じ人だと確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 身分証の氏名順序と予約名の本人照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: My identification says Tran An. Could you verify that we're the same person?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the name order on your identification and ask for it to be matched to the reservation name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 身分証と予約の詳細を照合します。予約を取り直す必要があるかは、その後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll compare your identification with the booking details. After that, we'll let you know whether a new reservation is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、新しい予約は作らずに待ちます。料金が二重になるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二重課金を避け新規予約せず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll wait without making a new booking. I'd like to avoid being charged twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait without making a new booking to avoid double charges. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照合ができましたので、今の予約で手続きを進めます。登録するお名前も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: We've verified the details, so we'll proceed with your existing reservation. Let's also confirm the name to register.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 身分証と同じ順番でお願いします。次の予約からもその順番に統一します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録氏名を身分証の順序へ統一するよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please use the same order as my identification. I'll use that same order for future reservations too.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the registered name to follow the order on your identification consistently. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは鍵をお渡しします、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Here is your key. Please enjoy your stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆さんで地図をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you all like to look at the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人三人と来ましたが、見たい場所が違うので別行動にします。帰りに迷わない集合地点を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自由行動後に迷わない集合地点の希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came with three friends, but we want to see different places, so we'll split up. I'd like to choose a meeting point so we don't get lost when it's time to leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a meeting point where nobody will get lost after exploring separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出発された入口と、帰るときの交通手段は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you use the same entrance and means of transport when you leave as when you arrived?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝は友人の車でした。帰りも同じ車で、駐車した場所の写真があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰りの車と駐車場所の資料を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: We came in a friend's car this morning. We'll leave in the same car, and I have a photo of where it's parked.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the car you will use to leave and the information you have about its parking location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら写真と地図で駐車位置を照合し、車の近くのわかりやすい目印を選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's match the parking location on the photo and map, and choose an easy-to-recognize landmark near the car.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 地図のこの表示を集合地点にします。全員に同じ写真を送れば伝わりやすそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図上の共通目印を選び写真を共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll choose this marker on the map as our meeting point. Sending everyone the same photo should make it clear, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a shared landmark on the map and share the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうですね。集合時刻も決めておくと、別々の予定を立てやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Deciding the meeting time too will make it easier to plan your separate activities.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰る準備の時間を考えて、四時に集合と送ります。遅れそうな人は連絡することにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集合時刻と遅れる際の連絡ルールを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Allowing time to get ready to leave, I'll send a message saying we'll meet at four. Anyone who may be late should let the others know.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide the meeting time and a rule to contact the others if running late. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送った内容を全員が見たか、返事も確認してから出発されてはいかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before you set off, why not check everyone's replies to make sure they've all seen your message?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人がまだ返事をしていないので、別行動を始める前に直接伝えてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未返信の友人に直接集合内容を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: One person hasn't replied yet, so I'll tell them directly before we start exploring separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will directly tell the friend who hasn't replied about the meeting arrangements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 皆さんに伝わると安心ですね。それでは、楽しい一日をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's reassuring once everyone knows. Have a lovely day.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのシャツは、もう一つ大きいサイズもございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: We also have that shirt in the next size up.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今のサイズは体には合いますが、腕を伸ばすと袖が短く感じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 腕を伸ばした際に袖が短いと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: This size fits my body, but the sleeves feel short when I stretch my arms out.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the sleeves feel short when you stretch your arms out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 試着できる商品ですので、大きい方もお持ちしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can try this item on. Shall I bring the larger one too?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 比べたいのでお願いします。身幅が広くなりすぎないかも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 大きいサイズで身幅も比較したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please; I'd like to compare them. I also want to see whether it becomes too wide around the body.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the body width in the larger size too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが大きい方です。鏡の前で腕をゆっくり動かしてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the larger one. Try moving your arms slowly in front of the mirror.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袖はこちらの方が楽ですが、肩が少し落ちます。小さい方と並べて見てもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 肩の違いを述べ二サイズを並べる許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: The sleeves are more comfortable on this one, but the shoulders hang a little low. May I put it beside the smaller one to look?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the shoulder difference and ask to place the two sizes side by side. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: もちろんです。肩と袖の両方が合うか、もう一度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of course. Please check again that both the shoulders and sleeves fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は仕事用を探しているので、動きやすい大きい方にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事での動きやすさを基準に大きい服を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm looking for something for work today, so I'll choose the larger one that's easier to move in.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the larger garment based on ease of movement at work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。お会計に進む前に、気になる点は残っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Before we go to the checkout, is there anything else you're concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 洗うと縮む素材か、表示を読んで確かめたいです。洗濯の記号を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入前に洗濯表示と縮みの注意を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd like to read the label to check whether the fabric shrinks in the wash. Could you explain the washing symbols?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Before buying, check the care label and any warnings about shrinkage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一緒に表示を読みましょう。お選びいただきありがとうございます、またお立ち寄りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's read the label together. Thank you for choosing it. Please visit us again.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品の解説をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for information about the artwork?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この絵の題名を知りたいのですが、近くの札には番号しか見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作品札で題名が見つからないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to know the title of this painting, but I can only find a number on the nearby label.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you can't find the title on the artwork label and ask for help. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの番号でしょうか。解説の一覧と照らし合わせてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which number is it? Let's compare it with the list of descriptions.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二十三番です。隣の二十二番の説明を、この絵のものだと思って読んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作品番号と隣の解説を誤読したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Number 23. I was reading the description of number 22 next to it, thinking it was for this painting.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the artwork number and say you mistakenly read the neighboring description as its description. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一覧では二十三番に「無題」とあります。題名を付けていない作品なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: The list says “Untitled” for number 23. So it's a work without a title.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「無題」も題名の欄に書く言葉なのですね。制作年はどこを見ればわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無題の意味を確認し制作年の欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: So “Untitled” is also something written in the title field. Where can I find the year it was made?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm what “Untitled” means and ask where the creation year is listed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号の右側の欄に制作年があります。作者の説明は、さらに下の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: The creation year is in the column to the right of the number. The artist's description is in a field farther down.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。先に制作年を見てから、作者の説明をゆっくり読んでみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 制作年と作者説明を順に読む予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll check the year first, then take my time reading the artist's description.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to read the creation year and then the artist's description. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。一覧を見ながら作品に戻るときは、ほかのお客様の通り道にもご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. When you return to the artwork while looking at the list, please be mindful of other visitors' path too.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、通路の真ん中では読まず、横へ寄ってから作品を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 解説を読む場所を通路から外すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I won't read in the middle of the passage. I'll step aside before looking at the work again.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will move out of the passage to read the description. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号を確かめながら、どうぞ鑑賞をお楽しみください。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy the artwork while checking the numbers. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの駅へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which station are you heading to?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待ち合わせのメッセージには和歌山駅とありますが、今いる和歌山市駅と同じ駅ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 和歌山駅と和歌山市駅が同じか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: The message about our meeting says Wakayama Station. Is that the same station as Wakayamashi Station, where I am now?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether Wakayama Station and Wakayamashi Station are the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名前は似ていますが、異なる駅です。お相手の案内に鉄道会社や出口の記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: The names are similar, but they're different stations. Does the other person's message mention the railway company or exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: JRの中央口と書いてあります。私はここで合っていると思って、切符も買いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待ち合わせの鉄道会社と出口の記載を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says the JR Central Exit. I thought this was the right place and even bought a ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the railway company and exit specified for the meeting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その記載なら、今の駅とは違いますね。切符の行き先を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: With those details, it's a different station from this one. Let me check the destination on your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ改札に入っていない切符がこちらです。買い直す前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未使用切符を見せ買い直し前の相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's the ticket; I haven't gone through the gates with it yet. I'd like to ask for advice before buying another one.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your unused ticket and ask for advice before buying a replacement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 切符の条件を調べてご案内します。待ち合わせまで時間に余裕はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the ticket conditions and explain your options. Do you have much time before the meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あと二十分なので、間に合わないかもしれません。友人には駅を間違えたとすぐ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残り時間と友人への遅延連絡を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only twenty minutes, so I may not make it. I'll tell my friend right away that I went to the wrong station.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the time remaining and say that you will notify your friend about the delay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのうえで、正しい目的地への経路を選びましょう。ここで切符の扱いも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let's choose a route to the correct destination. We'll also check what can be done with your ticket here.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。次は駅名だけでなく、JRという表示まで確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅名に加え鉄道会社を確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Next time I'll check not only the station name but also that it says JR.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the railway company as well as the station name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、行き先を照合してからお進みください。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please verify your destination before setting off. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お皿をお下げしてもよろしいでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 焼き魚が少し残っています。おいしいのですが満腹で、持ち帰れるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 満腹で残った焼き魚の持ち帰り可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a little grilled fish left. It's delicious, but I'm full, so I'd like to ask whether I can take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can take home the grilled fish left because you're full. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食品の状態やお店の対応によりますので、確認します。お帰りまでどのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: That depends on the food's condition and the restaurant's arrangements, so I'll check. How long will it take you to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電車と徒歩で一時間以上かかります。保冷する物も持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰宅所要時間と保冷手段がないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Over an hour by train and on foot. I don't have anything to keep it cool either.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the journey time home and that you have no way to keep the food cool. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状況では、持ち帰りをおすすめできないと担当者から返事がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge says that under those circumstances, we can't recommend taking it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。無理に持ち帰らず、残した分は下げてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち帰りを断念し残りの下膳を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't insist on taking it home; please clear what's left.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give up taking it home and ask for the leftovers to be cleared. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。次回は量について、注文前にご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. Next time, you can ask about portion sizes before ordering.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。今日は一皿の量を見ていなかったので、次は人数に合う量を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回は注文前に人数に合う量を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I didn't check the amount on one plate today, so next time I'll ask what quantity suits our group size.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that next time you will ask about a quantity suited to the number of diners before ordering. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご注文を決める際にお声がけください。お会計もご用意しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please speak to us when deciding your order. Shall I also prepare your bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、食事は終わりにします。飲み物も含めた明細をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食事終了と飲み物を含む会計明細を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll finish my meal here. Please give me an itemized bill including the drinks.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you are finishing the meal and ask for an itemized bill including drinks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 明細をお持ちします。本日はありがとうございました、またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll bring the itemized bill. Thank you for visiting today. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 材料を運ぶ前に、手元の図面を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before moving the materials, let's check the drawings you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ場所の図面が二枚あり、寸法が違います。どちらで準備すればよいか判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図面二枚の寸法相違と判断できない点を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two drawings of the same place with different dimensions. I can't decide which one to use for preparation.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the differing dimensions on two drawings and that you can't decide which to use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 版の番号を読めますか。寸法が違う位置も指してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you read the revision numbers? Please also point to where the dimensions differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらは二版、もう一枚は三版です。入口の幅が異なっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 図面の版番号と変更箇所を指示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is revision two, and the other is revision three. The entrance widths are different.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the drawings' revision numbers and point out the changed area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現場で承認された版を照合します。それが済むまで材料の切断は始めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check which revision was approved on site. Don't start cutting the materials until that's done.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 切断はまだしていません。別の人にも、確認が終わるまで待つよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切断未着手と同僚への待機連絡を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I haven't started cutting yet. I'll tell the other person to wait until the check is complete too.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that cutting hasn't started and that you will tell your coworker to wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。承認記録では三版が現在の作業用と確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. The approval record confirms that revision three is the current working version.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では三版を使います。二版は混ざらないよう、作業台から分けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確定した新版の使用と旧版の分別を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll use revision three. May I move revision two away from the workbench so they don't get mixed up?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will use the verified new revision and separate the old one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、旧版とわかるよう区別して保管してください。三版の変更箇所も一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please store it separately so it's clearly identifiable as the old revision. We'll also check the changes in revision three together.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の寸法を読み合わせてから、必要な材料の長さを書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更寸法を読み合わせ材料長を訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: After reading out the entrance dimensions together, I'll correct the lengths of the materials we need.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will read the changed dimensions together and correct the material lengths. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で進めましょう。それでは打ち合わせを終わります、お疲れさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's proceed in that order. That concludes our discussion. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与を受け取る口座についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about the account for receiving your salary, right?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社からこの用紙をもらいましたが、氏名がカタカナで途中までしか書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先の給与用紙で氏名が省略されていると相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company gave me this form, but my name is only partially written in katakana.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice about your name being shortened on your employer's salary form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの用紙は勤務先が作成したものですね。ご本人の氏名がわかる書類もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: This form was prepared by your employer, correct? Do you also have a document showing your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードを持っています。本名は用紙より長いので、そのまま提出してよいか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人確認書類と正式氏名の長さを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my residence card. My full name is longer than what's on the form, so I'm worried about submitting it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the identification document you have and that your full name is longer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 当行で登録する表記は書類と合わせて確認します。勤務先の用紙の訂正は、会社にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the name spelling to register at our bank against your documents. Please also ask your company about correcting its form.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀行が用紙を書き直すのではなく、会社に正しい記入方法を聞くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社用紙の訂正確認先が勤務先だと聞き返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the bank won't rewrite the form; I should ask my company how to fill it in correctly, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that your employer is whom you should ask about correcting the company form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、名義の表記が食い違わないよう、ご本人と勤務先で確認することが大切です。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. It's important for you and your employer to check so that the account-holder name doesn't differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は申請を急がず、会社に氏名の省略が意図したものか尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申請を延期し氏名省略の意図を会社に尋ねると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't rush the application today. I'll ask my company whether shortening my name was intentional.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to postpone the application and ask your company whether the shortened name was intentional. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談の内容を控えて、次回お持ちいただけるようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Let's keep a record of what we discussed so you can bring it next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。確認した表記をメモに残し、カードと会社の回答を一緒に持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名表記の記録と会社の回答を次回持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll make a note of the confirmed name spelling and bring my card together with the company's answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that next time you will bring a record of the name spelling and your company's answer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしております。それでは、書類をお忘れなくお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-030-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you. Please remember to take your documents with you as you leave.

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 列車が出たあともホームにいらっしゃいますが、お探し物ですか。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're still on the platform after the train has left. Are you looking for something?

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき降りた列車に、右の手袋を置いてきたようです。追いかけずにここで相談したいです。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 下車後に右の手袋を忘れたと説明して駅員への相談を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think I left my right glove on the train I just got off. I'd like to ask for help here rather than chase after it.
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you left your right glove after getting off and choose to ask a station employee for help. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その判断で大丈夫です。何時ごろ着いた列車の、どのあたりに座っていましたか。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's the right thing to do. About what time did the train arrive, and where were you sitting?

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時二十分ごろ着いた二両編成で、後ろの車両の窓側でした。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着時刻と二両編成の後方窓側の席を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was a two-car train that arrived around 10:20. I was by the window in the rear car.
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the arrival time and your window seat in the rear car of the two-car train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車両の位置は控えました。手袋の特徴を、ほかのものと区別できるように教えてください。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've noted the car location. Please describe the glove so it can be distinguished from others.

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 灰色の毛糸で、手首の内側に青い糸で名前を縫ってあります。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 灰色の毛糸と内側の青い名前の刺繍を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's gray wool, with my name stitched in blue thread on the inside of the wrist.
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the gray wool and the name embroidered in blue on the inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 特徴も伝えますね。連絡先を伺う前に、今夜までこの町にいらっしゃるか確認できますか。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll pass on those details too. Before I ask for your contact details, may I check whether you'll be in this town until tonight?

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は鳥取市に泊まりますが、明朝出発するので、見つかった場合の受け取り先も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌朝の出発を伝え発見時の受け取り先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm staying in Tottori City today, but I'm leaving tomorrow morning, so I'd also like to know where to collect it if it's found.
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention your departure tomorrow morning and ask where to collect it if found. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発見場所によって受け取り先が変わりますので、連絡時にご説明します。まず窓口で遺失物の申告をしましょう。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-09.translation: The collection location depends on where it's found, so we'll explain when we contact you. First, let's file a lost-property report at the counter.

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先は窓口で記入します。明朝出る予定も申告に添えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口で連絡先を記入し翌朝の予定も添えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my contact details at the counter. Could you also add my plans to leave tomorrow morning to the report?
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will write your contact details at the counter and ask to include tomorrow morning's plans. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、出発の予定も引き継ぎます。窓口までお気をつけて、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-031-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, we'll pass on your departure plans too. Please take care on your way to the counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は風が強いですね。屋外の予定を変更なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: It's windy today. Would you like to change your outdoor plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 砂丘を歩く予定でしたが、父が杖を使っているので、屋内中心に組み替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 杖を使う父のため砂丘から屋内の観光へ変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: We planned to walk on the sand dunes, but my father uses a cane, so I'd like to rearrange our sightseeing to focus on indoor places.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to switch from the dunes to indoor sightseeing for your father, who uses a cane. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 屋内の展示を候補にできます。展示の内容と、座って休める場所ではどちらを優先なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We could consider an indoor exhibition. Which matters more to you: the exhibition content or places to sit and rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父は昔の暮らしに興味があります。途中で座れる施設なら、そちらを先に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昔の暮らしの展示と途中の座れる場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My father is interested in life in the past. If there's a facility where he can sit down along the way, we'd like to visit that first.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for an exhibition about life in the past and places to sit along the way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郷土の展示がある施設を候補にして、休憩場所も確認しましょう。階段を避ける必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's consider a facility with local-history exhibits and check the rest areas too. Do you need to avoid stairs?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 階段は避けたいです。入口から展示室まで、エレベーターで行けるか調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段を避ける展示室までのエレベーター経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'd like to avoid stairs. Could you check whether we can get from the entrance to the exhibition rooms using an elevator?
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about an elevator route to the exhibition rooms that avoids stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 施設に確認する項目に入れます。移動は車ですか、それとも公共交通機関ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll include that in our questions for the facility. Will you travel by car or public transport?

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: タクシーを使うつもりです。入口近くで降りられる場所も一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: タクシーで入口近くに降りられる場所の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: We plan to use a taxi. I'd also like to check where we can get out near the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check a taxi drop-off location near the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、展示室への経路と乗り降りの場所を問い合わせます。結果を待つ間、こちらの椅子をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll ask about the route to the exhibition rooms and the pickup and drop-off locations. Please use these chairs while you wait for the answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 父をここで休ませます。条件が合わなければ、今日は一か所だけにして無理をしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 父を休ませ条件次第で見学を一か所に絞ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll let my father rest here. If the conditions don't suit us, we'll limit today to one place and won't push ourselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your father will rest and that you will limit the visit to one place depending on the conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認後に、負担の少ない候補をお伝えします。お父さまもどうぞゆっくりお過ごしください、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-031-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: After checking, I'll tell you about options that are less demanding. Please let your father take his time and rest too. Goodbye.
